qualifies_reason: Independent, self-published print magazine with four issues since March 2025, the latest in October 2026.
what_it_is: A print menswear magazine grown out of the Permanent Style website, focused on tailoring, craft and the makers behind classic men's clothing. Each issue carries long interviews and reportage, often built around a city or region, with recent issues on Scotland and Los Angeles. It is aimed at readers interested in bespoke clothing, shoemaking and well-made menswear.
